primary_source_refs.message:
fix(recoverssm): keep boundary-ending speculative state in its block (#860)

In align mode, a speculative window whose accepted tokens ended exactly on a recurrent block boundary selected the next, possibly unallocated block for the committed state. The commit was skipped while the bookkeeping advanced, corrupting GLM-5.3 (MTP/DFlash with prefix caching) and Kimi-K3 recurrent state. Select the block holding the last committed token in both places.

Root cause first identified by astra on the Local Inference Lab Discord.

Signed-off-by: Martin Vit <martin@voipmonitor.org>
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
